claim_ceiling: Source-faithful reproduction of the published two-agent leader-follower nonreciprocal Vicsek model and its influence/information analysis; not a claim that transfer entropy is causal, or that collective influence demonstrates biological life or intelligence.

publication.title: Quantifying influence and information transfer in a modified Vicsek model with nonreciprocal interactions

source_code.software_execution_note: The repository README documents a Python analysis environment, while Symtropy's reproduction will use a separate pinned Rust implementation. Do not import the Python analysis package into production.

model.interaction_matrix_orientation: W[i,j] is the influence weight of source j on receiver i (receiver rows, source columns)
model.update_equation: theta_i(t+dt) = wrap(theta_i(t) + sum_j(A_ij * |W_ij| * wrap(theta_j(t)-theta_i(t))) / sum_j(A_ij * |W_ij|) + epsilon_i(t))
model.noise: epsilon_i ~ Uniform[-eta/2,+eta/2), sampled independently for each particle and update
model.movement: constant speed along updated heading; periodic wrap

pairwise_source_configuration.reason_all_to_all: For two particles on a square torus of side 5, the maximum minimum-image separation is sqrt(2)*2.5 ~= 3.536, below R=5; every pair is in range at all positions.

stochastic_reproducibility.source_initialization: numpy.random.default_rng() with no explicit seed for positions and headings
stochastic_reproducibility.source_noise: non_reciprocal_update constructs a fresh numpy.random.default_rng() without a seed on each update call
stochastic_reproducibility.correct_reproduction_target: Reproduce deterministic equations and reported aggregate trends using registered Rust seeds; compare distributions/aggregates rather than pretending exact stochastic trajectory parity with the unseeded source.
stochastic_reproducibility.source_noise_caveat: The original pairwise driver launches one run per parameter combination; because the initial state and per-step noises are unseeded, its exact trajectories cannot be regenerated from the published driver alone.

source_influence_estimators.A_at: Mean absolute pairwise influence over the analysis window: sum_t |I_{target<-source}(t)| divided by the number of analysed frames (the source passes an all-ones adjacency tensor).
source_influence_estimators.A_ta: Absolute net signed pairwise influence: absolute value of sum_t I_{target<-source}(t) divided by the number of analysed frames.
source_influence_estimators.warning: These are physically defined model contributions in the weighted-angle update, not generic causal scores; preserve their exact names and formulas.

estimator_sensitivity_pipeline.caveat: These are distinct estimator profiles and must be reported separately; do not silently pool their outputs.

source_analysis_caveats: The pairwise analysis sets adjacent_matrix to an all-ones tensor. This is valid for the published pairwise configuration because R=5 makes every pair mutually in range in a 5x5 torus, but it must not be generalized to local-neighbour settings.
Source analysis drops the first 1000 steps as a stationarity burn-in.

The source script uses float16 storage for orientation, noise, influence and velocity trajectories; a Rust reproduction should retain f64 internally and explicitly quantize only when comparing to source file formats.

benchmark_tasks: Reproduce the weighted wrapped-angle update and row-receiver/source-column interaction-matrix semantics.
Reproduce the leader-follower wLF grid and eta sweep under a registered, seeded Rust protocol.
Compare the source pairwise influence estimators A_at and A_ta with direct controlled intervention effects.
Measure transfer entropy separately from interventional influence under source-matched noise sweeps.
Test the dual noise effect: influencer noise versus follower noise at fixed wLF.
Test estimator sensitivity across 8-bin histogram, box-kernel and kNN/metric estimators.
Extend to visual-sector perception only after source-faithful metric-neighbour reproduction is established.
Extend from two agents to collective populations with common-driver and shuffled-source controls.
anti_leakage: Use fixed Rust seeds and publish seed lists; do not label them as source trajectory parity.
Split by entire seed and parameter point, not time frames.
The wLF and noise grid must be registered before any optimization.
Compare source and Rust aggregate statistics over enough registered seeds to quantify uncertainty.
Do not treat TE, mutual information, SURD or PID as causal proof; use paired interventions as the causal reference.

source_summary_metrics.A_at: mean absolute per-frame directed model component
source_summary_metrics.A_ta: absolute value of mean signed per-frame directed model component

rust_reference.burn_in: reset_influence_accumulator() allows cumulative A_at/A_ta tracking to begin after the registered 1,000-step source burn-in
rust_reference.stochasticity: explicit seeded xorshift64 stream; compare source aggregate distributions, not source trajectory identity
rust_reference.intervention: intervene_heading() records explicit heading changes without consuming or resetting the RNG; clone before intervention for a matched sham

noise_modes.source_faithful: One scalar angular-noise width from the paper's pairwise driver is applied to all particles; constructors new() and random_uniform() preserve this mode.
noise_modes.oli_extension: new_with_noise_profile() accepts one full-width angular-noise interval per particle, validated finite in [0, 2π]. This permits influencer-noise versus follower-noise ablations while preserving the scalar source profile separately.
noise_modes.seeded_stream: Per-agent noise draws use the same explicit sequential RNG stream; zero-width agents still consume their draw to keep the draw count stable across noise profiles.

rust_reference_cases.description: Intervene to reverse a source's heading between analysis frames; mean absolute influence must exceed absolute mean signed influence
Clone pre-intervention state and PRNG; intervene on leader and compare follower's downstream heading to sham
rust_reference_cases.expected: nonzero downstream difference with matching future RNG stream
zero-noise receiver has no stochastic heading perturbation; high-noise receiver changes under the registered seed

expected: reject non-finite and out-of-range noise widths

required_aggregate_comparison: transfer entropy by wLF and eta
